            for i_tile in T.serial(S // TILE_M):

                    s_k = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_N, TILE_K), dtype="float16", scope="shared")

                    s_attn = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_M2, TILE_K2), dtype="float32", scope="shared")
                    s_v    = T.alloc_buffer((TILE_K2, TILE_N2), dtype="float16", scope="shared")

                    for ti in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_M2), thread="threadIdx.y"):
                        for td in T.thread_binding(T.serial(TILE_N2), thread="threadIdx.x"):

                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K2):

                                                          i_tile * TILE_M2 + ti,
                                                          kk_tile * TILE_K2 + kk]
                                # load V tile (col)

                                                    d_tile * TILE_N2 + td]

                                for kk in T.serial(TILE_K2):
